friction_intervention.declared_coefficient_is: Actual native sliding coefficient assigned to ALL colliding geoms, not mu squared; no explicit contact pairs; wheel priority1, other0
friction_intervention.CEM_profile_range_caveat: The original native task validator caps profile mu at1. The original training contract remains mu0.7; the new runner explicitly sets actual native material and predictor mu0.01–2. No clipping, validator relaxation or monkeypatch is used. Reports retain actual compiled readback.

metrics.XY_descriptive_screen: RMSE>0.15m OR peak>0.30m, evaluated separately for core and reference overlap; below the screen is not a task-completion verdict
metrics.persistent_XY_event: Time-synchronous XY>0.30m continuously for at least0.10s; onset and confirmation are reported separately
metrics.beta_target: Intended nonzero reference side-slip; neither beta nor wheel-heading offset is a mismatch or zero-slip target
metrics.ground_heading_eligibility: Each wheel independently: measured contact_count>0 AND upward worldFz>5N, with geometric/speed-valid masks; absence is not classified as flight
metrics.PPO_reward_limitation: Saved PPO recordings lack full-body contact-force histories required by all15 reward terms; missing reward totals are not fabricated.

observed_failure_patterns: NEW400Hz PPO+beta at mu0.15 has core/whole XYRMSE0.10505/0.08302m, core speed100.29%, coursechange58.64deg versus reference59.26deg. Do not reuse an older low-friction failure label.
PPO+beta at mu0.01 retains103.63% speed but coursechange-0.81deg, core/whole XYRMSE1.16151/2.44895m. The trace also has substantial roll/tilt: this is not proven stable-contact pure understeer.

PPO+beta at mu0.05 and0.10 retains22.02% and30.84% core speed; whole XYRMSE2.70058/2.27125m. Low-speed gaps invalidate complete course-change estimates. Low beta RMSE with poor eligibility cannot be called good tracking.
CEM+beta at mu0.15 has coreXYRMSE0.11029m but whole0.35769m, peak0.59542m, persistent departure onset4.02s and core speed113.51%. A core-only score misses the late overshoot.
PPO-beta nominalmu0.7 already fails late: coreXYRMSE0.14806m masks whole0.73832m and persistent departure beginning4.1125s. Do not attribute a nominal failure newly to friction.
PPO-beta at mu2.0 also departs: core/wholeXYRMSE0.49151/1.40122m. Responses are strongly nonmonotonic; no universal critical mu or success probability is established.
At nominalmu0.7, CEM+beta wholeRMSE0.12951m coexists with peak0.45556m and late persistent departure6.5s. A low RMSE alone is not full success.
